title: hrabanazviking/RuneForgeAI-Project-Aesir
summary: RuneForgeAI-Project-Aesir 是一个基于Bare-metal Mojo推理引擎，专为本地主权设计。它具备零拷贝GGUF解析、分页的PagedAttention KV缓存和无状态采样器。针对消费级硬件优化，消除了对云的依赖和冗余，以在边缘提供高性能、私有的AI服务。
description: Bare-metal Mojo inference engine designed for local sovereignty. Features zero-copy GGUF parsing, PagedAttention KV caching, and a stateless sampler. Optimized for consumer hardware, it eliminates cloud dependency and bloat to deliver high-performance, private AI directly on the edge.
